notes: This run located no independently new 0-inclusive original Retail 12.1.5 operation ledger. Prior Cardinalai/Honeybone/kyzenbka/JD3K/MikiMM and WoWhead cumulative Looter cohorts excluded, not restated as new measurements. Independent mechanic crosscheck (not a cast cohort): https://www.wow-professions.com/midnight/enchanting-specialization-guide-and-builds states disenchanting ignores Resourcefulness, Multicraft and Ingenuity; the guide says rare/epic tools both confer +18 skill, and rare rod plus two rare accessories totals +40 skill. This corroborates M13's previous single-guide 'likely' classification; Master should review before updating mechanics.md. No inference of exact yield, per-rank rate or histogram.
